name: index_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY experiences sharp 1-minute directional bursts when macro news hits or algorithmic momentum strategies trigger cascading entries via TWAP/VWAP algorithms working large directional orders. These bursts exhibit autocorrelation at the 30-60 second scale because institutional orders are typically only 40-60% filled in the first 12-bar (1-min) window, leaving residual order flow that sustains the move. When both the 5-minute trend (ret_60) and the 1-minute acceleration (ret_12) confirm the same direction, we are entering during active institutional order completion rather than at the exhaustion of a move.

indicators.name: ret_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute return — SAME time window as original (5 × 1-min bars = 60 × 5s bars). This is the CONTEXT FILTER: confirms a sustained directional move is underway, not a random spike. Using the same 5-minute horizon as the original is correct because the underlying thesis is about 5-minute institutional flow patterns — that time window is fundamental to when TWAP algorithms complete meaningful order slices.

indicators.name: ret_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute return — NEW layer not in original. At 1-min bars the original could not distinguish slow drift from fast burst within a 5-min trend. At 5s resolution we can detect the 1-minute acceleration that confirms the 5-min trend is actively continuing (not fading). Entry requires BOTH layers aligned: 5-min trend active AND 1-min momentum confirming in the same direction.

buy_ce.confirmation: Both conditions must hold on the same bar — trend context plus immediate acceleration

buy_pe.confirmation: Both conditions must hold on the same bar — trend context plus immediate deceleration

exit.stop_rationale: 3 points because momentum continuation is a high-conviction trade: if NIFTY does not continue moving within 30s, the thesis (residual institutional order flow) is already wrong. A 3-pt option stop corresponds to ~6 spot points — momentum that stalls or reverses 6 pts within 30s is not institutional continuation but a fade. Tightest stop of any strategy class because time is the real stop.
exit.target_rationale: 5 points captures ~40% of the expected 1-min continuation (1-min NIFTY moves average 12-15 spot pts = 6-8 option pts at delta 0.5). Targeting 5 of ~7 expected points gives 1:1.67 R:R while keeping time-in-trade short. Taking 100% of the move would require holding through noise.

filters.vix_filter: none — momentum trades work across volatility regimes; high VIX amplifies both signal and noise equally
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; skip first 5 minutes (09:15-09:20) to avoid pre-open noise
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is always sufficient for ATM options
filters.trend_filter: ret_60 threshold acts as implicit trend filter
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — momentum strategies are crowded at 1-min+ horizons; at 5s the crowding is lower but the signal window is narrow

adaptation_notes: Original used 1-min bars with a single 5-min return. At 5s resolution the single-layer signal is insufficient — slow 5-min drift and fast 1-min burst look identical on 1-min bars but are different at 5s. Added ret_12 (1-min layer) as a confirmation gate. This filters out entries during 5-min trends that are decelerating (often the last 2-3 minutes before reversal). Original hold was 1-10 min; compressed to 15-120s to target only the fast continuation leg, reducing exposure to mean-reversion risk. Stop/target converted from 0.3% of spot (~75pts NIFTY) to option premium points: 0.3% spot ≈ 37pts option move at delta 0.5, but we target the first 5 pts of a continuing burst, not the full 37-pt equity move.
weaknesses: In choppy low-volatility sessions (NIFTY range < 50pts), 5-min returns rarely exceed 0.2% — few signals generated
Back-to-back momentum bursts in the same direction can trigger multiple entries; time_stop_bars limits exposure but not signal frequency
ret_60 is a lagging measure — if 5-min trend stalls exactly at entry, the 1-min confirmation may arrive at the worst moment
No VIX filter means entries can fire during extreme volatility when ATM options gap by 20+ pts between bars
